entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Rama Pati Shukla, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Srinivas Bajpai, the learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 0383 of 2021, under Sections 363, 366, 376 of IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, 2012,
Police Station Lalganj, District Pratapgarh.
3.

The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 22.06.2021 at 19:44 hrs against four named accused persons, including the applicant, alleging that the applicant had enticed away the informant's daughter aged about 15 years at about 01:00 am on 19.06.2021.
4.
In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that she had herself made a phone call to the applicant at 01:00 am on 20.06.2021 and she had gone with him.
The applicant made her drink some substance after which he had committed the misdeed with her.

1 5.

A similar statement was given by the victim before the doctor, who had conducted her medico legal examination, but no external injury was found on her body and no fresh injury was reported on her hymen.

6. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she reiterated her earlier statement but she did not give any reply to the categorical question as to what misdeed was committed by the applicant.
7.

In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has falsely been implicated in the present case and that he has no previous criminal history.
8. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the allegations levelled against the co-accused persons could not be established during investigation.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the the incident occurred in the night of 19.06.2021 yet the FIR has been lodged in the evening of 22.06.2021; that the allegation of rape is not there either in the FIR or in the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. or in her statement recorded before the magistrate; it has been added subsequently in the additional statement recorded by the Investigation Officer after the victim's statement had been recorded by the Magistrate and the statement of the informant and the victim has not been recorded till date in spite of a specific order dated 11.10.2022 passed by this Court, coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 24.06.2021 , I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
10. Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.
12. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
13. The trial court to comply with the order dated 11.10.2022 within a period of two month.
